Laser Scar Revision in Bangalore

Improve the appearance of acne, surgical and injury-related scars with advanced laser scar revision at NeoSculpt6. Our dermatologist-led treatments use precision laser technology to stimulate collagen remodelling, improve skin texture and help scars become less noticeable over time.

Need Help? Call Us · +91 99640 60483

What Is Laser Scar Revision?

Laser scar revision is a dermatological procedure that uses focused laser energy to improve the appearance of scars. The treatment remodels damaged scar tissue, stimulates collagen production and encourages healthier skin regeneration. The laser creates microscopic treatment zones within scar tissue.

The treatment breaks down irregular scar tissue while preserving the surrounding skin. Laser therapy stimulates collagen production, allowing healthier connective tissues to develop. As collagen remodels, the appearance of the scar gradually improves and becomes smoother.

Plan Your Laser Scar Revision Around Your Skin and Treatment Goals

The consultation reviews the diagnosis or concern, skin type, previous treatment, relevant medicines, recent sun exposure, recovery expectations and whether a laser or combination approach is appropriate. The plan is confirmed before treatment rather than using one standard protocol.

Why Choose NeoSculpt6 for Laser Scar Revision?

Laser Scar Revision is planned around the diagnosis or concern, skin type, treatment suitability and realistic expectations.

  • 01

    Assessment Before Treatment

    Every scar is different. At NeoSculpt6, our dermatologists assess the type of scar, skin condition and treatment goals before creating a customised treatment plan.

  • 02

    Treatment Matched to Your Skin

    Using advanced laser technology and combination therapies, we help improve scar texture, reduce scar visibility and stimulate long-term collagen remodelling. Advanced fractional laser systems target scar tissue precisely while protecting the surrounding skin and encouraging healthy healing.

  • 03

    Your scar treatment plan is customised according to the type of scar, depth, age, location and skin type. Our laser scar treatment protocols are designed for Indian and sensitive skin, reducing risks while delivering effective scar improvement.

  • 04

    We treat acne scars, surgical scars, burn scars and trauma scars using evidence-based scar revision techniques.

OUR PROCESS

Our Laser Scar Revision Process

A dermatologist evaluates the type of scar, size, depth and overall skin condition.

Assessment of skin type, scar age and expected healing response.

A customised treatment plan is developed based on your scar characteristics.

The treatment area is cleansed and topical anaesthesia or numbing cream may be applied if required.

Fractional laser energy targets scar tissue to stimulate collagen remodelling and improve the appearance of the scar.

Detailed aftercare instructions help minimise redness, support the healing process and reduce complications.

Multiple sessions may be recommended depending on the size of the scar, type of scar and treatment goals.

Who Can Benefit from Laser Scar Revision?

  • Acne Scars

    Treatment for atrophic scars, rolling scars and boxcar scars caused by acne.

  • Surgical Scars

    Laser scar treatment helps improve surgical scars after complete wound healing.

  • Trauma Scars

    Scars resulting from injuries may respond well to laser scar revision depending on the type of scar.

  • Burn Scars

    Selected mild to moderate burn scars may benefit from laser therapy and collagen remodelling.

  • Post-Inflammatory Scar Changes

    Treatment for uneven skin texture and residual scar tissue after healing.

Suitability depends on the diagnosis, skin type, severity, medical history, previous treatment and realistic goals.
